entities.summary: General Sir Henry de Beauvoir De Lisle,, known as Beauvoir De Lisle, was a British Army officer and sportsman. He served in both the Second Boer War and the First World War, where he commanded the 29th Division for nearly three years, leading it in the Gallipoli campaign and later at the Battle of the Somme, before taking over the command of a corps.
